comparison.why: Corrected patient-versus-household clinical units, while replacing unsupported earnings with judged otherwise-paid medical cash savings and coherent completion/response gates; not an observed performance change.

incomePathways.rationale: Same household and same-year medical spending, net work resources and net additional access costs are jointly logged. Only positive gains are overlap-adjusted; full negatives remain.
incomePathways.counterfactual: Other primary-care/FQHC providers, Medicaid/CHP+, insurance, and otherwise-paid medical care. Positive work benefits apply only to an adult/caregiver subgroup with clinical response.
